description:
Compaction can persist state above the known committed version (KCV) and label it as an older durable snapshot. Cold recovery then treats the future value as committed history. This violates the recovery invariant `materializer durable state <= KCV <= recovery version`.

Confirmed at `8f962e09` through the production compaction and cold-load paths; this is not a full-cluster fault-injection test.

## Reproduction

Save the following as `/tmp/repro.exs` and run `MIX_ENV=test mix run --no-start /tmp/repro.exs`:

```elixir
alias Bedrock.DataPlane.{Transaction, Version}
alias Bedrock.DataPlane.Materializer.Olivine.{Database, IndexManager, Index, Logic}
alias Bedrock.DataPlane.Materializer.Olivine.Index.Page
alias Bedrock.Internal.TransactionBuilder.{State, Tx, RangeReads}

v1 = Version.from_integer(100)
v2 = Version.from_integer(200)
base = Path.join(System.tmp_dir!(), "bedrock-evaluation-#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}")
File.mkdir_p!(base)
{:ok, db0} = Database.open(:evaluation, Path.join(base, "db"))
encode = fn mutations, version -> Transaction.encode(%{mutations: mutations, commit_version: version}) end
{im1, db1} = IndexManager.apply_transaction(IndexManager.new(), encode.([{:set, "a", "old"}, {:set, "b", "keep"}, {:set, "c", "keep"}], v1), db0)
{data1, _} = db1
{:ok, db1, _} = Database.advance_durable_version(db1, v1, Version.zero(), data1.file_offset, [IndexManager.get_complete_page_map(im1)])
{im2, db2} = IndexManager.apply_transaction(im1, encode.([{:set, "a", "future"}], v2), db1)
state = %Bedrock.DataPlane.Materializer.Olivine.State{database: db2, index_manager: im2, known_committed_version: v1}
{:ok, task} = Logic.start_compaction(state)
receive do
  {:compaction_ready, _dfd, _ifd, dp, ip, _, _, _, version, _, _, _} ->
    IO.inspect({Version.to_integer(version), File.read!(List.to_string(dp))}, label: "compaction claimed version and persisted bytes (KCV=100, future value at 200)")
    recovered = Path.join(base, "recovered")
    File.mkdir_p!(recovered)
    File.cp!(List.to_string(dp), Path.join(recovered, "data"))
    File.cp!(List.to_string(ip), Path.join(recovered, "idx"))
    {:ok, restored_db} = Database.open(:restored_evaluation, Path.join(recovered, "db"))
    {:ok, restored_im} = IndexManager.recover_from_database(restored_db)
    [{_, {restored_index, _}} | _] = restored_im.versions
    {:ok, _, loc} = Index.locator_for_key(restored_index, "a")
    IO.inspect({Version.to_integer(restored_im.current_version), Database.load_value(restored_db, loc)}, label: "cold-recovered value and claimed version")
    Database.close(restored_db)
after 5_000 -> raise "compaction did not finish"
end
Task.await(task)

Database.close(db2)
File.rm_rf!(base)
```

Observed: compaction reports version 100 and contains `futurekeepkeep`; reopening the compacted files returns `{100, {:ok, "future"}}`. Version 100 should contain `"old"`; the version-200 mutation must not become durable while KCV remains 100.

## Cause and affected paths

[lib/bedrock/data_plane/materializer/olivine/logic.ex](https://github.com/bedrock-kv/bedrock/blob/8f962e09b24765265eeb6bd818f5b26da8d91b99/lib/bedrock/data_plane/materializer/olivine/logic.ex#L436) takes the latest in-memory page map. [lib/bedrock/data_plane/materializer/olivine/database.ex](https://github.com/bedrock-kv/bedrock/blob/8f962e09b24765265eeb6bd818f5b26da8d91b99/lib/bedrock/data_plane/materializer/olivine/database.ex#L136) stamps that map with `IndexDatabase.durable_version/1` without selecting the corresponding historical state. `upload_snapshot_before_spindown/1` takes the same latest map and uses the same compactor, so the snapshot path needs the same correction. Idle retirement is opt-in and currently lacks production wiring; explicit compaction already reaches this code.

## Acceptance criteria

- Every compacted/snapshotted index represents exactly its advertised version, which cannot exceed KCV.
- With durable=100, applied=200, KCV=100, compaction and cold reopen retain the version-100 value.
- Also cover applied > durable when all applied mutations are committed: replaying from the advertised baseline must not apply atomic mutations twice.
- Cover snapshot upload, cold replacement, and rollback of an uncommitted tail.

title: Olivine compaction persists future state under an older durable version
